title: Adjacency-Smoothed 24-Layer Refinement with Reduced Step Size
scientific_hypothesis: Applying an adjacency-smoothing penalty to discourage abrupt thickness jumps between consecutive high-index layers will improve robustness while maintaining or improving the target score, as the current best design shows thickness dispersion that may be fabrication-sensitive.
design_principle: Regularize the thickness profile by penalizing large differences between adjacent HfO2 layer thicknesses, encouraging gradual gradients rather than discontinuous jumps. This follows the feedback directive to probe whether smoother periodic approximations can extract remaining performance without fabrication-sensitive discontinuities.
proposed_topology: Air | (HfO2 | SiO2) × 12 | Fused Silica substrate - exactly 24 finite layers with alternating HfO2/SiO2 sequence, HfO2 first
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
Minimize thickness gradient between adjacent HfO2 layers
manufacturing_considerations: Smoothing penalty reduces sensitivity to deposition thickness errors
Outermost layer is SiO2 for environmental durability per evidence
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflectance bands
Gradient regularization reduces fabrication sensitivity in non-quarter-wave designs
expected_advantages: Improved robustness score through smoother thickness profile
Maintained or improved target score from iteration_16 baseline of 0.842
Reduced risk of fabrication errors causing spectral degradation
known_risks: Smoothing constraint may limit achievable target score if optimal design requires thickness discontinuities
May converge to local optimum if step size reduction is too aggressive
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer HfO2/SiO2 alternating stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Initialize thicknesses from iteration_16 best candidate: [113.65, 61.50, 156.31, 62.55, 170.70, 58.41, 119.61, 64.73, 137.92, 56.84, 163.13, 65.05, 127.37, 60.87, 190.57, 63.37, 158.79, 62.54, 189.79, 64.87, 125.60, 68.59, 144.52, 46.09] nm. Apply gradient_thickness optimizer with 40% reduced step size relative to baseline. Add adjacency-smoothing penalty term that penalizes |thickness_H[i] - thickness_H[i+2]| for consecutive HfO2 layers. Evaluate over 300-1700 nm wavelength range with coherent smatrix solver. Maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm and mean reflectance in 300-450 nm simultaneously. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: low transmission in 300-450 nm; low reflection in 1000-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30; materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Following feedback directive: apply 40% reduction in optimizer step size and introduce adjacency-smoothing penalty to regularize high-index layer dispersion. Initialized within ±15 nm of iteration_16 best candidate to probe smoother periodic approximations.
